stories.title: Sacramento considers banning horse-drawn carriage rides in Fab 40s during holidays
stories.summary: Sacramento City Council is considering an annual ban on for-hire horse-drawn vehicles in the Fab 40s to address holiday-season safety concerns.

stories.title: Sacramento brewery closing its doors at year’s end
stories.summary: In an Instagram post Saturday, New Helvetia Brewing Co. announced it will be closing its taproom doors at the end of the year.

stories.title: Sacramento Weather Forecast
stories.summary: The first big storm delivered big valley rain and Sierra snow. Sunday into Monday, another system will move into the area.

stories.title: Sacramento Republic FC's Western Conference Final postponed to Monday
stories.summary: Sacramento Republic FC's Western Conference Final against New Mexico United has been postponed to Monday due to travel delays.

stories.title: Man dies in Fairfield shooting as police investigate
stories.summary: A man was found shot in the roadway Saturday night in Fairfield and pronounced dead at the scene, according to police.

stories.title: Sacramento airport transportation businesses feel effects of flight ground stop
stories.summary: Rental cars saw a surge in demand, while ridesharing dried up.

stories.title: Shelter-in-place order issued in Colfax after propane leak
stories.summary: A leaking residential propane tank prompted a shelter-in-place order for a street near Dallimore Road in Colfax.

stories.title: Man wounded in South Sacramento shooting on Winnett Way
stories.summary: Sacramento police are investigating a shooting on Winnett Way that left a man with non-life-threatening injuries.

stories.title: Teen accused in deadly Fairfield Halloween store shooting pleads not guilty
stories.summary: A teenager accused of killing a pregnant woman and injuring six others at a Fairfield Spirit Halloween store has pleaded not guilty.

stories.title: Sacramento airport travelers face lingering disruptions Saturday, one day after nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: Travelers at Sacramento International Airport experienced ongoing delays Saturday after a nationwide ground stop Friday, affecting flights and luggage.

stories.title: Democrat Sean Frame concedes California Senate District 6 race
stories.summary: Democrat Sean Frame conceded his campaign for California Senate District 6 after a close race against Republican incumbent Roger Niello.

stories.title: Public invited to honor Dolores Huerta at state Capitol on Nov. 16
stories.summary: The public can pay respects to labor leader Dolores Huerta at the California State Capitol on Nov. 16 from noon to 6 p.m.
